column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:type module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable module for type-lattice reflection. Import binds the `type`
# namespace: `"aql:type-util" import end  TypeUtil.word Type`.
# §1  parent — the immediate supertype in the lattice
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.parent Integer
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.parent Float
# §2  root — the branch root
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.root Integer
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.root String
# §3  swap form
aql:type-util import end  Integer TypeUtil.parent
# §4  tpartial — make every field of a Record/Object type optional (moved here)
aql:type-util import end  (TypeUtil.tpartial (refine Record [x:Integer])) istype
# §5  negative — unbound without import
TypeUtil.parent Integer
tpartial (refine Record [x:Integer])
# §6  reflection & set-algebra over the type lattice
# alts — the alternatives of a disjunct as a List of types
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.alts (Integer tor String)
# arityof / paramsof / returnsof — function-signature reflection
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.arityof (fn [[a:Integer b:Integer] [Integer] [a add b]])
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.paramsof (fn [[a:Integer b:String] [Integer] [a]])
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.returnsof (fn [[a:Integer] [Integer] [a]])
# brand — a nominal subtype tagged with an atom (swap-arg: tag then base)
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.brand userid/q Integer
# exclude / extract — TypeScript-style set difference / intersection (swap form: target op what)
aql:type-util import end  (Integer tor String) TypeUtil.exclude String
aql:type-util import end  (Integer tor String) TypeUtil.extract Integer
# lca — least common ancestor in the lattice
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.lca Integer Float
column3: common supertype of Integer and Float

column1: # merge — combine two record types (swap form: a op b)
aql:type-util import end  (refine Record [x:Integer]) TypeUtil.merge (refine Record [y:String])
# nominal — mint an anonymous nominal alias of a base type
aql:type-util import end  (TypeUtil.nominal Integer) istype
# omit / pick — drop / retain named fields (swap form: record op [names])
aql:type-util import end  (refine Record [x:Integer y:String]) TypeUtil.omit [x/q]
aql:type-util import end  (refine Record [x:Integer y:String]) TypeUtil.pick [x/q]
# required — strip the optional (None) alternative from every field
aql:type-util import end  TypeUtil.required (refine Record [x:(Integer tor None)])
